raw.commentary: Three plots show strong internal causality and complete arcs, but the relationship plot admits three broken causal links and pads a Morpheus-rescue event, the society plot is truncated at ev-018 missing its betrayal/capture/resolution, and the objective and impact faith plots are near-identical rehashes, driving hard marks on P1, P3, P4, P5 with only moderate perspective drift on P2.
